from types import MappingProxyType
from solution import select_route


class ReviewProbe(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_standard_readonly_mapping_record(self):
        record = MappingProxyType({'address': '8.8.8.8', 'priority': 0})
        result = select_route([record])
        self.assertIs(type(result), dict)
        self.assertEqual(result, dict(record))

import unittest

from solution import select_route


class SelectRouteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_selects_smallest_priority(self):
        records = [
            {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": 20},
            {"address": "1.1.1.1", "priority": 3},
            {"address": "9.9.9.9", "priority": 10},
        ]
        before = [dict(record) for record in records]
        result = select_route(records)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"address": "1.1.1.1", "priority": 3})
        self.assertEqual(records, before)
        self.assertIsNot(result, records[1])

    def test_priority_tie_uses_earliest_position(self):
        records = [
            {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": 1},
            {"address": "1.1.1.1", "priority": 1},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(select_route(records), {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": 1})

    def test_ignores_malformed_and_non_global_records(self):
        records = [
            None,
            [],
            {"address": "8.8.8.8"},
            {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": 1, "extra": True},
            {"address": 123, "priority": 1},
            {"address": "not-an-ip", "priority": 0},
            {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": True},
            {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": -1},
            {"address": "127.0.0.1", "priority": 0},
            {"address": "10.0.0.1", "priority": 0},
            {"address": "192.168.0.1", "priority": 0},
        ]
        self.assertIsNone(select_route(records))

    def test_empty_and_generator_inputs(self):
        self.assertIsNone(select_route([]))
        records = ({"address": address, "priority": priority} for address, priority in [
            ("8.8.8.8", 2), ("1.1.1.1", 1)
        ])
        self.assertEqual(select_route(records), {"address": "1.1.1.1", "priority": 1})

    def test_each_call_returns_a_fresh_dictionary(self):
        records = [{"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": 0}]
        first = select_route(records)
        second = select_route(records)
        first["priority"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(second, {"address": "8.8.8.8", "priority": 0})
        self.assertEqual(records[0]["priority"], 0)

    def test_invalid_container(self):
        for value in ("records", b"records", 4, None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    select_route(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
